description: Cross-language contract for credential resolution precedence (US4, FR-019/FR-020, CC-005, ADR 0005). Precedence: injected credential > primary (Entra ID) > API-key / connection-string fallback > NoCredentialAvailable. Modeled at the observable-behavior level with fakes; no live Azure. 'primary_available' models whether the Entra ID primary path can resolve; 'env' supplies fallback configuration.

cases.description: The primary path is unavailable and an API key is configured: resolution falls back to the API key and the operation can proceed.
The primary path is unavailable and a connection string is configured: resolution falls back to the connection string.
The primary path is unavailable and no fallback is configured: resolution raises NoCredentialAvailable.
When the primary path is available it takes precedence over a configured fallback.
An explicitly injected credential takes precedence over both the primary path and any fallback.
